steps.title: Sample Preparation and SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Prepare samples and perform SDS-PAGE as usual.

steps.title: Prepare Transfer Buffer and Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the transfer buffer and soak materials during the SDS-PAGE run.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Timmons-Dunbar Buffer 1X using ultrapure water (typically 50 mL per mini gel of 8.4cm x 7cm).
Soak 12 WypAll X60 sheets (cut to gel size, Kimberly-Clark Catalog #34865) in Timmons-Dunbar Buffer 1X.

steps.title: Prepare PVDF Membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare the PVDF membrane for transfer.

substeps.instruction: Discard methanol from the membrane.
Overlay the membrane with Timmons-Dunbar Buffer 1X (membrane will usually float).

steps.title: Assemble Semi-Dry Transfer Sandwich
steps.instruction: Assemble the transfer sandwich, removing bubbles with a roller.

substeps.instruction: Layer the components in the following order: Bottom electrode, 6 x WypAll X60 buffer-soaked sheets, pre-wet PVDF membrane, 6 x WypAll X60 buffer-soaked sheets, Top electrode.

steps.title: Perform Semi-Dry Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel to the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gel from the electrophoresis chamber (do not wash the gel, as remaining SDS is important for transfer).
Perform transfer at 0.325 mA/mm² for 7 minutes for 0.75mm mini gels.
Note: For >150 kDa proteins, use 10 min (2.5 A; up to 25 V for 2 mini gels or 1 midi gel; 1.3 A; up to 25 V for 1 mini format gel).

steps.title: Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Disassemble the sandwich.
Transfer the membrane to 3% non-fat dry milk diluted in TBS-T (Tris Buffered Saline with 0.05% Tween 20).
Incubate with gentle rocking for 1 hour.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Pour off blocking solution and overlay membrane with TBS-T; rock gently for 5 minutes (Wash 1/3).
Pour off washing solution and overlay with desired primary antibody (suggested starting dilution 1:1,000 in TBS-T with 1% BSA and 0.02% sodium azide).
Incubate with gentle rocking for 1 hour at room temperature or up to 16 hours at 4°C.

steps.title: Post-Primary Antibody Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane after primary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Pour off washing solution and overlay membrane with TBS-T; rock gently for 5 minutes (Wash 2/3).
Pour off washing solution and overlay membrane with TBS-T; rock gently for 5 minutes (Wash 3/3).
Collect antibody and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the HRP-conjugated secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Overlay membrane with horseradish peroxidase (HRP) conjugated antibody (suggested starting dilution 1:10,000 in TBS-T).
Incubate for 1-3 hours at room temperature with gentle rocking.

steps.title: Post-Secondary Antibody Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane after secondary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Pour off secondary antibody and overlay membrane with TBS-T; rock gently for 5 minutes (Wash 1/3).
Pour off washing solution and overlay membrane with TBS-T; rock gently for 5 minutes (Wash 2/3).
Pour off washing solution and overlay membrane with TBS-T; rock gently for 5 minutes (Wash 3/3).
Mix 1 mL of 'Stable Peroxide Solution' with 1 mL of 'Luminol Enhancer Solution' (e.g., SuperSignal™ West Pico PLUS, Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #34577) in a clean container.

steps.title: Develop X-ray Film
steps.instruction: Detect proteins using chemiluminescence and X-ray film.

substeps.instruction: Gently transfer the membrane to the substrate container using tweezers (grab by the border) and rock for a few seconds.
Transfer the wet membrane to an X-ray cassette, sandwiching it between two transparent hard plastic foils.
In a dark room, place an X-ray film over the sandwich and expose for 1 minute (adjust time as needed).
Remove film and incubate in diluted autoradiography developer solution for 30 seconds.
Rinse with tap water.
Incubate in diluted autoradiography fixer solution for 1 minute.
Rinse with tap water and let dry.
Overlay the dried film over the original cassette sandwich to align with the prestained marker, stick to a blank sheet of paper, and scan.
